name: taxonomy_create_category
description:
Create a new category in the taxonomy hierarchy under a specified parent category.

Use this tool when:
- A new category is needed to properly organize the taxonomy
- You need to add a missing intermediate category
- Creating a new leaf category for classification

Parameters:
- parent_id: The ID of the parent category (must exist)
- new_label: The label for the new category (e.g., "industrial_machine")
- description: A clear description of what this category represents (optional but recommended)

Example:
  create_category(492, "industrial_machine", "Machines used in manufacturing and industrial processes")

The tool will:
1. Validate the parent exists
2. Normalize the label (lowercase, underscores)
3. Check for duplicates under the same parent
4. Create the new category
5. Return the new category_id

Note: If a category with the same label already exists under this parent, the tool will return an error with the existing category's ID.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.description: ID of the parent category under which to create the new category

inputs.name: new_label
inputs.description: Label for the new category (will be normalized to lowercase with underscores)

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for taxonomy_create_category:

parent_id (required): ID of the parent taxonomy category
label (required): Name of the new category (snake_case)
description (optional): Description of the new category

Example:
{
    "parent_id": 772,
    "label": "not_started",
    "description": "The task or process has not begun."
}
